questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if Oak Tree and Keyton are close competitors and there are not many alternatives or if one is a major supplier to competitors of the other.
Provide a view on whether consumers consider land lease communities and over-55s strata communities to be substitutable with retirement village accommodation.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Oak Tree and/or Keyton.
